# All settings

<!-- Generated by tools/manual/gen_reference.py from config.py and the import page: do not edit. -->

Every setting, as it is written in a settings file or `project.toml` (`[section]`, `name = value`), with its default and, where it has one, its label on the [import page](../guide/import-page.md). A channel is given by number or by name.

## `[input]`

The input: the export or stack, the dataset, its channels and pixel size.

| Setting | Default | On the import page | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | (none) |  | an IDEAS export (.zip, one folder per dataset) or an ImageJ hyperstack from ImageStreamCombiner (.tif, one frame per event) |
| `output` | `'output'` |  | the results go to a folder named after the dataset (or stack) in this folder |
| `max_events` | (empty) | Only the first N events (empty = all) | analyse only the first N events (by object number); empty = all |
| `dataset` | (empty) |  | IDEAS zip: the dataset (folder in the zip); empty = the only one |
| `channels` | `[]` |  | IDEAS zip: the channels to load (IDEAS numbers Ch&lt;N&gt;); the channels with a role are always loaded |
| `channel_names` | `[]` |  | IDEAS zip: their names, in the same order as channels |
| `pixel_size` | (empty) |  | µm per pixel; required for an IDEAS zip (its files do not hold it) |

## `[channels]`

The roles of the channels (by number or by name).

| Setting | Default | On the import page | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brightfield` | `1` |  | the brightfield channel |
| `marker_of_interest` | `2` |  | the marker whose enrichment at the interface is measured |
| `tumor` | `3` |  | the tumor-cell marker |
| `immune` | `[4]` |  | the immune-cell marker(s), a list; several are each normalized and summed (2.8: phenotypic markers) |
| `functional` | `[]` |  | immune subtype markers, a list: positive or negative per immune cell (2.8: functional markers) |
| `marker_location` | `'nuclear'` | Tumor / immune markers | where the tumor and immune markers stain: "nuclear" (nucleus or cytoplasm) or "membrane"; sets the image for Cellpose |
| `cell_of_interest` | `'Immune cell'` | Marker of interest expressed in | the cell type that expresses the marker of interest: "Tumor cell" or "Immune cell" |

## `[segmentation]`

Cellpose and the clean-up of the cells.

| Setting | Default | On the import page | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | `'cellpose'` |  | "cellpose", or "labelmap": load the labels of labelmap_file instead |
| `labelmap_file` | (empty) |  | labelmap_cells.tif (or the macro's .zip) of an earlier run |
| `model` | `'cyto3'` | Model (cyto3, cpsam, or a path) | Cellpose 3: cyto3, cyto2, nuclei, ...; Cellpose 4: cpsam; or the path of a model |
| `diameter` | `30.0` | Cell diameter (px) | the typical cell diameter in pixels; 0 = Cellpose estimates it (Cellpose 3 only) |
| `flow_threshold` | `0.5` |  | Cellpose's flow threshold (higher: more, less certain cells) |
| `cellprob_threshold` | `0.0` |  | Cellpose's cell probability threshold (lower: larger cells) |
| `use_gpu` | `true` | Use the GPU | run Cellpose on the GPU |
| `reuse_labels` | `true` | Reuse the previous Cellpose result if nothing changed | reuse the Cellpose result of the previous run of the dataset when its input image and Cellpose settings are the same (labelmap_cells.tif and .json in the dataset folder); off = always run Cellpose |
| `montage_columns` | `0` | Montage columns (0 = square) | events per row of the montage that Cellpose segments; 0 = about square; the number of events = one row, as the Fiji macro |
| `cellpose_python` | (empty) | Python with Cellpose | python.exe of an environment with Cellpose 3 or 4; empty = this one |
| `erosion` | `1` | Shrink cells (px) | shrink the cells from the background by this many pixels |
| `min_cell_size` | `100` | Min. cell size (px) | smaller cells (in pixels, after shrinking) are removed |
| `max_cell_size` | `10000` | Max. cell size (px) | larger cells (in pixels, after shrinking) are removed |
| `exclude_edge_cells` | `false` | Leave out cells cut by the image edge | leave out cells cut by the edge of their event image (they are always marked: column Edge) |

## `[classification]`

Subtype thresholds, artefacts and pools.

| Setting | Default | On the import page | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `threshold_method` | `'MaxEntropy'` | Threshold of the subtype markers | the automatic threshold of the subtype markers, on log(intensity - min + 1): "MaxEntropy" (as 2.8), "MaxEntropy strict" (at least 2 robust SDs above the negative cells), "Otsu", "Yen" or "RenyiEntropy" |
| `thresholds` | `{}` | Thresholds set by hand (Apply in a dashboard) | thresholds set by hand, by marker name: { "Subtype A" = 12.5 } (background-subtracted intensity); they replace the automatic ones |
| `artefact_min_positive` | (empty) | Artefact: positive in at least N subtype markers (0 = none) | a detection positive in at least this many subtype markers is an artefact, not a cell; empty = all of them (with two or more markers); 0 = no artefacts |
| `pool` | `'experiment'` | Classify together (one set of thresholds) | in a project: "experiment" classifies the datasets of each experiment together (one set of thresholds), "dataset" each dataset on its own |

## `[membrane]`

The membrane profiles and the enrichment.

| Setting | Default | On the import page | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `analysis` | `false` | Membrane profiles and enrichment | the membrane profiles and the enrichment at the interface (the per-event interface table is always made) |
| `cells` | `[]` | Membrane of (e.g. Tumor, Immune, A+; empty = where the marker is expressed) | the cells whose membrane is measured, a list of: a cell type ("Tumor", "Immune"), an immune subtype as in the tables ("Immune A+ B+"), or a marker ("A+": immune cells positive for A); empty = channels.cell_of_interest |
| `partners` | `[]` | Interface with (empty = the other cell type) | the partners whose contact is the interface, as for cells; empty = the other cell type |
| `thickness` | `3` | Membrane / interface width (px) | pixels: the width of the membrane band, and the distance at which cells touch |
| `straightening_width` | `5` | Straightening width (px) | pixels: the width of the band across the outline that is straightened |
| `max_histogram_value` | `20.0` | Histogram maximum (SD) | the end of the histograms (SD above the mean); they start at -5 |
| `histogram_bin_width` | `0.25` | Histogram bin width (SD) | the bin width of the histograms (SD) |
| `control_repeats` | `10` | Control windows per cell | random control windows per cell without an interface, each as long as the median interface |
| `inside_only` | `false` | Straighten inside the measured cell only | take the profile only from the part of the band inside the measured cell (a sensitivity test, not a separation: touching membranes are far closer than the resolution, so every pixel there mixes both) |
